target_customer: Media and content companies needing custom synthetic voices for audiobooks, podcasts, dubbing and voice overs
problem: Traditional speech synthesis needed hours of one speaker's recordings and sounded robotic; media producers wanted natural custom voices cheaply.
business_model: Upfront fee per custom voice plus per-usage fee

founders.name: Andrew Gibiansky
prior_employers: Baidu Research (led deep learning speech synthesis team)

founders.name: Bobby Ullman
founders.background_notes: Described in coverage as a childhood friend of the other founder

exit.reason: Cause not stated in sources reached

technical_complexity.rationale: Neural speech synthesis trained on hundreds of voices at once was research-grade in 2018; the founders built the engine in about two and a half months thanks to prior Baidu experience.

defensibility.rationale: Team expertise was the edge, but WaveNet-style methods were published and large labs were investing heavily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Big platforms offered neural voices as cloud APIs and more voice startups followed; Voicery shut down in 2020 with no acquirer found.

market_need_then: Demand for audiobooks, podcasts and dubbing at lower cost; TechCrunch in March 2018 reported a few customers piloting and none announced.

branding.community_and_virality: Press mostly from TechCrunch in 2018; a Reddit thread on its shutdown in September 2020.

brand_strength.rationale: Some launch press but little evidence of brand pull; name resembles Voicy and Voices.com.

outcome_analysis: Voicery was a two person neural speech synthesis team from Baidu and Palantir that joined YC in Winter 2018 and shut down around September to October 2020. The cause is not public in the sources found. Large platforms were offering neural voices and the company showed only pilot customers at launch, but no source ties those facts to the closure, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: Shutdown date from a Reddit post dated 2020-09-24 and a Deepgram page saying October 2020 (the Deepgram page is a generic summary). Reddit thread itself could not be fetched. Aggregators list a pre-seed, seed and Series A with no amounts; unverified so not recorded as rounds. TechCrunch says the company was bootstrapped apart from YC. No dated competitor source found, list left empty.
